b1-3ind.title: Possession: Aandi, Aandak, Aandah...
b1-3ind.pattern: عندي / عندك / عنده / عندها / عندنا / عندكم / عندهم
b1-3ind.explanation: Arabic has no verb "to have" — instead, Emirati uses عند (aand, literally "at/by") fused with a person ending: عندي (aandi, "I have"), عندك (aandak, "you-m have"), عنده (aandah, "he has"), عندها (aandaha, "she has"), عندنا (aandana, "we have"), عندكم (aandakum, "you-all have"), عندهم (aandahum, "they have"). Negate it with ما: ما عندي (ma aandi, "I don't have").
b1-3ind.fact: عند expresses lasting/permanent possession (owning something), which is different from مع (ma3a, "with") used for what someone is physically carrying right now — a distinction English doesn't make with a single word "have."

dialogue.en: Yes, I have money, thank God

b1-lian.title: Because: Lian
b1-lian.explanation: لأن (li-ann, "because") introduces a reason: أنا تعبان لأن رحت البيت أمس (ana ta3baan li-ann riHt el-bayt ams, "I'm tired because I went home yesterday"). It always comes right before the reason clause, same position as English "because."
b1-lian.fact: لأن can also open a sentence to answer a "why" question directly: ليش انت تعبان؟ لأن ما شربت قهوة (leish inta ta3baan? li-ann ma shirabt gahwa — "Why are you tired? Because I didn't drink coffee").

items.ar: هي تعبانة اليوم لأن راحت البيت مع الأهل
items.en: She's tired today because she went home with the family
items.translit: hiya ta3baana el-yoom li-ann raaHat el-bayt ma3a el-ahl

items.ar: احنا زين اليوم لأن عندنا صديق زين كثير
items.en: We're good today because we have a very good friend
items.translit: i7na zayn el-yoom li-ann aandana sadeeq zayn katheer

items.ar: أشرب قهوة اليوم لأن عندي فلوس، والحمد لله
items.en: I drink coffee today because I have money, thank God
items.translit: ashrab gahwa el-yoom li-ann aandi fluus, wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: راح البيت مع صديق أمس لأن عنده فلوس زين
items.en: He went home with a friend yesterday because he has good money
items.translit: raaH el-bayt ma3a sadeeq ams li-ann aandah fluus zayn

items.ar: يوم الجمعة أنا مبسوط لأن عندي بيت جديد
items.en: On Friday I'm happy because I have a new house
items.translit: yoom el-jum3a ana mabsoot li-ann aandi bayt jideed

items.ar: هي زعلانة اليوم لأن ما عندها فلوس كثير
items.en: She's upset today because she doesn't have a lot of money
items.translit: hiya za3laana el-yoom li-ann ma aandaha fluus katheer

lessons.title: Where Are You Going and Why?

items.ar: وين تروح الحين؟ أروح البيت لأن تعبان
items.en: Where are you going now? I'm going home because I'm tired
items.translit: wein truu7 el-heen? aruu7 el-bayt li-ann ta3baan

items.ar: وين يروح بعدين؟ يروح البيت مع صديق زين
items.en: Where's he going later? He's going home with a good friend
items.translit: wein yruu7 ba3dayn? yruu7 el-bayt ma3a sadeeq zayn

items.ar: وين تروح الحين؟ تروح البيت لأن عندها فلوس
items.en: Where's she going now? She's going home because she has money
items.translit: wein truu7 el-heen? truu7 el-bayt li-ann aandaha fluus

items.ar: وين تروحون بعدين؟ نروح البيت مع الأهل زين
items.en: Where are you all going later? We're going home with the family, good
items.translit: wein truu7oon ba3dayn? nruu7 el-bayt ma3a el-ahl zayn

items.ar: عندي واحد اليوم لأن ما عندي اثنين
items.en: I have one today because I don't have two
items.translit: aandi waahid el-yoom li-ann ma aandi ithnayn

items.ar: عنده ثلاثة اليوم لأن شاف أربعة أمس
items.en: He has three today because he saw four yesterday
items.translit: aandah thalaatha el-yoom li-ann shaaf arba3a ams

items.ar: عندها خمسة اليوم لأن عندها فلوس كثير زين
items.en: She has five today because she has a lot of good money
items.translit: aandaha khamsa el-yoom li-ann aandaha fluus katheer zayn

items.ar: عندنا ستة اليوم لأن شفنا سبعة أمس زين
items.en: We have six today because we saw seven yesterday, good
items.translit: aandana sitta el-yoom li-ann shifna sab3a ams zayn

items.ar: رحت يمين لأن عندي صديق يمين اليوم
items.en: I went right because I have a friend to the right today
items.translit: riHt yameen li-ann aandi sadeeq yameen el-yoom

items.ar: راح يسار لأن البيت يسار اليوم زين
items.en: He went left because the house is to the left today, good
items.translit: raaH yasaar li-ann el-bayt yasaar el-yoom zayn

items.ar: عندها بيت قدّام لأن التاكسي قدّام اليوم
items.en: She has a house in front because the taxi is in front today
items.translit: aandaha bayt guddaam li-ann et-taaksi guddaam el-yoom

items.ar: عندنا بيت ورا لأن الأهل ورا البيت اليوم
items.en: We have a house behind because the family is behind the house today
items.translit: aandana bayt wara li-ann el-ahl wara el-bayt el-yoom

items.ar: صباح الخير، أشرب قهوة، وبعدين أروح البيت
items.en: Good morning, I drink coffee, and later I go home
items.translit: sabaah el-khayr, ashrab gahwa, wa ba3dayn aruu7 el-bayt

items.ar: رحت البيت أمس، وشفت الأهل، وشربت قهوة زين
items.en: I went home yesterday, and I saw the family, and drank good coffee
items.translit: riHt el-bayt ams, wa shift el-ahl, wa shirabt gahwa zayn

items.ar: عندي فلوس اليوم لأن ما رحت البيت الغالي
items.en: I have money today because I didn't go to the expensive house
items.translit: aandi fluus el-yoom li-ann ma riHt el-bayt el-ghaali

items.ar: مساء الخير، أنا مبسوط اليوم لأن عندي أهل زين

items.translit: masaa el-khayr, ana mabsoot el-yoom li-ann aandi ahl zayn

items.ar: عندي بيت كبير لأن عندي فلوس كثير، والحمد لله
items.en: I have a big house because I have a lot of money, thank God
items.translit: aandi bayt kabeer li-ann aandi fluus katheer, wal-hamdulillah

items.translit: riHt el-bayt ma3a sadeeq ams, wa shirabt gahwa zayn

items.ar: هي مبسوطة اليوم لأن عندها بيت جديد وصديق زين

items.translit: hiya mabsoota el-yoom li-ann aandaha bayt jideed wa sadeeq zayn

items.ar: ما عندهم فلوس كثير لأن عندهم بيت غالي كبير

items.translit: ma aandahum fluus katheer li-ann aandahum bayt ghaali kabeer
